title: Arrays
definition: An array is a contiguous block of memory holding elements of the same type.
content: An array is a contiguous block of memory holding elements of the same type.
intuition: Allows O(1) random access via indices due to contiguous memory allocation.
how_it_works: Elements are stored sequentially. Address of element i = base_address + i * element_size.
when_to_use: When random access is frequent and size is known or bounded.
when_not_to_use: When insertions or deletions in the middle are frequent.
complexity: Access: O(1), Search: O(n), Insertion/Deletion: O(n)
